notable_absence.finding: The page states a concrete, unconditional retention policy - 'Events in the Activity Log are automatically deleted after 2 years' - which has no home in the current predicate registry (not requiresSetting, not availableSince). Single occurrence in this batch, so not minted as a new predicate; flagged for the reconciler in case a 'retainsDataFor'-shaped predicate becomes worth minting once/if a second data-retention statement is found elsewhere in the docs set.

cross_component_finding: Confirms the escalation model end to end: an event's Severity field here links to the exact same #event-severity table in monitoring.md that back last round's monitoring:event concept, and the page explicitly notes that a Support Ticket can be created directly from an open event ('Click Create Support Ticket to create a support ticket related to that open event') - a concrete UI action tying monitoring:event to Capella's support-plan-gated ticketing system, though the text doesn't name which plan tier includes ticket creation (same vagueness already flagged in alert-reference.json's notable_absence).
